# Teckon® Quality Spares — Shreeji Hydraulics | Wholesaler & Suppliers Store for Auto Parts

> Shreeji Hydraulics (brand: Teckon® Quality Spares) is an ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer and premier Wholesaler & Suppliers Store for auto parts and earthmoving spares. Specializing in JCB, L&T, JD, Terex (colloquially known as TARAX), CAT, and heavy earthmoving machinery. Established in 2000 in Rajkot, Gujarat, India, the company supplies precision-engineered replacement parts across India.

## Key Facts

- **Legal Entity:** Shreeji Hydraulics
- **Brand Name:** Teckon® / Teckon Quality Spares
- **Tagline:** Wholesaler & Suppliers Store for Auto Parts
- **Wholesaler Focus:** JCB, L&T, JD, Terex (TARAX), CAT, Earthmoving Spares of Wholesaler
- **Founded:** 2000 (26+ years of hydraulic engineering expertise)
- **Headquarters:** 36-C, Gondal Rd, UDHYOGNAGAR, Bhakti Nagar, Rajkot, Gujarat 360002, India
- **Certifications:** ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System
- **Industry:** Construction Equipment Aftermarket Hydraulic Parts Manufacturing & Auto Parts Wholesale
- **Business Model:** B2B Wholesaler & Suppliers Store — wholesale, fleet, and dealer orders for earthmoving spares
- **Delivery Coverage:** Pan-India supply network; international B2B shipments available
- **Website:** https://teckon.vercel.app

## What We Do

Teckon® is a Wholesaler & Suppliers Store for auto parts and earthmoving spares. We manufacture and supply precision aftermarket replacement spares designed to match or exceed OEM specifications for heavy earthmoving and construction equipment. Our product range includes hydraulic pump assemblies, cylinder seal kits, control valves, pins & bushes, breaker & tipper parts, undercarriage components, filters, and general hydraulic accessories.

## Equipment Brands Served

JCB (3DX, 4DX, JS Series) · L&T · JD (John Deere / Tata JD) · Terex / TARAX (TLB840) · Caterpillar CAT (424B, 428E) · Hitachi (EX200, Zaxis ZX200) · L770 · Komatsu · Kobelco

## Product Categories

1. JCB Spares — gear pumps, seal kits, control valves, boom/dipper cylinders, pin & bush kits, filters
2. Hitachi Parts — main pump rebuild kits, swing motors, final drive motors, boom cylinder seals, track rollers, duo-cone seals
3. Terex Parts (also searched as TARAX) — lift cylinders, full seal kit sets, hydraulic steering units
4. CAT Components — control valves, bucket cylinders, gear pumps, seal kit bundles
5. Breakers & Tippers — accumulators, front head seal kits, telescopic cylinders
6. L&T / JD / L770 — track rollers, front idlers, drive sprocket segments
7. Excavator Parts — bucket cylinders, swing motors, travel motors, carrier rollers
8. General Hydraulics — high-pressure hose assemblies, BSP fittings, bladder accumulators
9. Filters & Service — hydraulic spin-on filters, primary air filters, diesel fuel filters
